user_decision: Retain industry-level allocation if construct validity and research meaning are preserved.

decision.reason: The original proposal already studies industry weights; allocation across sectors can encode institution-specific judgments without testing individual-stock selection.
decision.sufficiency_condition: Document interpretation must affect a genuine allocation choice; changing gamma alone is only a numerical control and does not establish strategic-judgment coverage.
decision.not_a_result: This is a design-level adequacy judgment, not a claim that treatment effects or sufficient statistical power have been observed.

research_question: Does a common AI preserve source-specific public sector judgments in justified equity-sector allocations, and how does early versus late evidence provision change that reflection?

period.claim: retrospective document-conditioned case, not point-in-time trading replay

inputs: common market evidence in the same sector taxonomy
dated institution documents containing relevant objectives, applicable constraints or sector judgments
main.document_roles: Legal investment mandates, fund-manager commentary and house research views are distinct evidence types. A house outlook is not silently assigned to an unrelated fund as its mandate.
main.risk_policy: Preserve qualitative preferences; retain only explicitly supported numerical limits, denominators and exceptions. Do not map real-fund prose to gamma.
model_decisions: propose sector weights and explain the evidence supporting departures from a common baseline when one is specified
main.gold_visibility: Offline provisional references mechanically cross-checked; independent human review pending; never read by online runner.
main.calculation: Implemented pure calculator; automatic same feedback between stages; no repair or hidden-reference access
main.calculator_information_boundary: Tools may use only evidence already exposed in that run and model-submitted inputs. Before R4 receives its institution packet, tools cannot read hidden mandates, evaluator annotations or institution-specific constraints. Missing constraints remain unknown; no automatic gold-based repair, lookup or informative feasibility response is allowed.
main.no_synthetic_real_facts: Do not invent institutional expected returns, confidence, sector caps or exact target weights from qualitative prose.
pending: Address the observed one-case failure if present; then complete and review the full pilot under explicitly versioned conditions
Prepare and validate v4.4 main-run path
Freeze inputs, model and rubric before main responses
main.representation: Researcher-selected short paraphrased evidence, original labels, source IDs and page locators; not full-document retrieval.
main.baseline: Reported 2026-06-30 S&P500 sector weights, sum99.9%, original preserved and normalized for common arithmetic; not institution holdings/targets
main.runtime_policy: Single-case v4.4 observations only. Remaining pilot cases, separate main-run path, human review and main freeze are pending.

workflow.interpretation: Evidence-onset and subsequent-use workflow policy, including position and context age; not an isolated memory mechanism.
workflow.retrieval: Directly supplied evidence first; actual retrieval quality remains a separate extension, not an executed RAG result.
workflow.inference: descriptive case study; two source documents, not powered population experiment
workflow.history_semantics: visible model responses and calculator feedback retained; not hidden thinking traces

dimensions: valid sector identifiers and feasible weights
institution-specific response under matched workflow comparison
evaluation.numeric_agreement: A unique exact-weight reference is used only for the independent numerical control. Public holdings or qualitative views do not specify universally correct strategic weights.
evaluation.convergence: Similarity alone is not failure. Report whether a convergence accompanies loss of relevant evidence or objective/constraint violations. Do not force differences when source judgments agree.
evaluation.counterfactuals: If constructed, change an explicitly identified condition while keeping others fixed and label these as synthetic task interventions, not real institution history.
evaluation.post_outcome_additions: Rubric refinements allowed on pilot only before main freeze; additions after main outcomes are exploratory, not revised confirmatory rules.
evaluation.primary_rating_scope: source label preservation only, not strategy quality

numerical_control.role: auxiliary check of explicit objective implementation; cannot substitute for the documentary strategic task
numerical_control.data_status: Revised historical French data; retrospective controlled task, not point-in-time trading reconstruction.
numerical_control.period_provenance: LIBERA adaptation: PortBench QA test years 2024-2025 plus Salcher 60-month lookback. Not PortBench pipeline replication.
numerical_control.inference: Overlapping fixed cases; no independent-sample or power claim. Shared optima retained. No future returns used.

legacy_v4.role: historical numerical prototype, not the new documentary main task
legacy_v4.audit_scope: The v4 two-round audit applies to archived v4 files and hashes only; it is not a certification of this revised documentary design.

model.settings_observation_scope: Versioned request conditions; actual observations are in the linked single-case transport records.
model.runtime_readiness_policy: Installation or pilot status is reported separately; this builder never certifies execution readiness.

base Qwen3.5-4B; explicit JSON and disabled thinking; not the LoRA adapter

model.backend_settings: Pin served digest, quantization, chat template, engine, context, sampling defaults and thinking implementation from actual runtime evidence.
model.context_overflow: fail and record; no silent truncation, history deletion or budget change
